title: Cross-document page transitions with the View Transitions API
summary: Four static pages joined by `@view-transition { navigation: auto }` in an inline head `<style>` inside the motion query, no router; `pageswap` names only the destination's tile (`media`, `title`) and `pagereveal` adds the `forward` / `back` type from the page order and names the tile returned to, cleared on `ready`; picture and name morph `.7 s` with `object-fit: cover` snapshots clipped to the moving box while the body slides `6 %` (`.4 s` out, `.6 s` in after `.12 s`), the bar held still; first frame held by `<link rel="expect" blocking="render">`; focus to the new `h1`; plain navigation without the API, no transition under reduced motion
variants: same-document document.startViewTransition under a client router
